title: MY11 exerts antitumor effects through activation of the NF-kappaB/PUMA signaling pathway in breast cancer.
authors: Ye, Qun; Jiang, Ziwei; Xie, Ying; Xu, Yuanhong; Ye, Yiyi; Ma, Lei; Pei, Lixia
one_liner_zh: 该文研究查尔酮衍生物MY11通过NF-kappaB/PUMA通路抑制乳腺癌，仅含p65分子对接的简单提及，核心为细胞与动物实验，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: Breast cancer is the most common malignancy in women worldwide, and the discovery of new effective breast cancer therapies with lower toxicity is still needed. We screened a series of chalcone derivatives and found that MY11 ((E)-1-(2-hydroxy-4,6-dimethoxyphenyl)-3-(4-piperazinylphenyl) prop-2-en-1-one) had the strongest anti-breast cancer activity. MY11 inhibited the growth of MDA-MB-231 and MCF-7 breast cancer cells by arresting the cell cycle and promoting apoptosis, through regulation of the cell cycle and apoptosis-related proteins. PDTC (Pyrrolidinedithiocarbamate ammonium), a specific inhibitor of the NF-kappaB pathway, abolished the inhibitory effect of MY11 treatment. NF-kappaB has been shown to regulate PUMA-dependent apoptosis. Our in vitro studies demonstrated that MY11 promoted breast cancer cell apoptosis by activating the NF-kappaB/PUMA/mitochondrial apoptosis pathway (including Bcl-2, Bax, and Caspase-9). MY11 also inhibited tumor growth in an orthotopic breast cancer mouse model by inducing apoptosis through the NF-kappaB signaling pathway, importantly, with minimal toxicity. In addition, MY11 was found by docking analysis to bind to p65, which might enhance the stability of the p65 protein. Taken together, our findings indicate that MY11 exerts a significant anticancer effect in breast cancer and that it may be a potential candidate for the treatment of breast cancer.
abstract_zh: 乳腺癌是全球女性中最常见的恶性肿瘤，目前仍需发现新型、低毒性的有效乳腺癌治疗方法。我们筛选了一系列查尔酮衍生物，发现MY11（(E)-1-(2-羟基-4,6-二甲氧基苯基)-3-(4-哌嗪基苯基)丙-2-烯-1-酮）具有最强的抗乳腺癌活性。MY11通过调控细胞周期和凋亡相关蛋白，阻滞细胞周期并促进凋亡，从而抑制MDA-MB-231和MCF-7乳腺癌细胞的生长。PDTC（吡咯烷二硫代氨基甲酸铵），一种NF-kappaB通路的特异性抑制剂，消除了MY11处理的抑制作用。NF-kappaB已被证明可调控PUMA依赖性凋亡。我们的体外研究表明，MY11通过激活NF-kappaB/PUMA/线粒体凋亡通路（包括Bcl-2、Bax和Caspase-9）促进乳腺癌细胞凋亡。MY11还通过NF-kappaB信号通路诱导凋亡，在正位乳腺癌小鼠模型中抑制肿瘤生长，重要的是，其毒性极低。此外，通过对接分析发现MY11与p65结合，这可能增强p65蛋白的稳定性。综上所述，我们的研究结果表明，MY11在乳腺癌中发挥显著的抗癌作用，并可能成为治疗乳腺癌的潜在候选药物。
